crew.overview: Follows the journey of a 90-year-old atheist and the quirky characters that inhabit his off-the-map desert town. He finds himself at the precipice of life, thrust into a journey of self-exploration.
crew.title: Lucky

details.biography: John Lang is an American film and series producer and the co-founder of Divide / Conquer. His most recent work includes Attack of the Murder Hornets (2021) and Spree (2020) which premiered at the 2020 Sundance Film Festival. His body of work as a producer has played at film festivals the world over and been distributed by companies such as Netflix, Hulu, Universal, and Warner Media. He is an alum of the 2014 Sundance Institute Feature Film Creative Producing Lab and Fellowship as well as being a graduate of The University of Texas at Austin and an Eagle Scout.
details.name: John H. Lang
